headline: Carhenge / Shandoka goes before Special Town Council on Wednesday, September 30
blurb: This special session is entirely devoted to one thing: a Town Council appeal hearing on the Carhenge lot subdivision. On July 23, 2026, P&Z unanimously approved consolidating Lots 34 and 34B at 700 W. Pacific Avenue into a single parcel — a preliminary step the Town needs before any redevelopment can move forward on that open-space site.
